title: Policy evaluation by sweeping
brief: Apply the Bellman equation as an update, sweep until the values stop changing, and check the result against the exact solve and the error guarantee.
hints: A synchronous sweep computes the whole new vector from the old one: r_pi + mdp.gamma * P_pi @ v. Don't overwrite v entry by entry during a sweep.
In iterative_policy_evaluation, count a sweep every time you call bellman_sweep, and return the new vector from the last sweep, not the one before it.
stopping_bound is one line: gamma / (1 - gamma) * last_change.
